verdict.rationale: Lambda has no documented bulk-action feature, but its programmable surfaces allow bulk work. The REST API can create and manage resources, so multi-instance operations can be scripted. The S3-compatible adapter supports bulk file tools like rclone and s5cmd, and Slurm and Kubernetes schedule workloads across many nodes. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints (e.g., terminating or launching many instances in one call), console multi-select actions, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
